lines.en: I lost my keys, and I can't find them anywhere.
My phone battery died, so I could not call you.
Don't worry, we can fix this together.
The internet is very slow today. Let's restart the router.
What should I do if I miss the bus?
I made a mistake, and I am sorry about it.
Can you help me carry these heavy bags?
The problem is that we don't have enough time.
Let's ask the manager. Maybe he has a solution.
Every problem has a solution if you stay calm.
